message.text:
The server starts `s3presign.Runner`, which runs once immediately on startup and then repeats every 12 hours via a ticker. This is driven by `server/server.go` and `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`.

`internal/scheduler` is unused by the server. `memopayload.Runner` is never invoked; only `RebuildMemoPayload` runs synchronously from API handlers. Four webhook worker goroutines start during `internal/webhook` package initialization, not through `Server.startBackgroundRunners`.

q28.
s3presign — `RunOnce` at startup, then `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)
unused: `internal/scheduler` cron scheduler is never imported or started by the server; `server/runner/memopayload` has a `Runner` but `NewRunner` is never called (only `RebuildMemoPayload` runs inline from Create/Update memo)

`Server.startBackgroundRunners` starts only the S3 presign runner. Webhook delivery uses four `init()` goroutines on a channel in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, not this runner loop.
